collection.description: A ceremonial stone wall blocks the easiest route to a new garden.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A ceremonial stone wall blocks the easiest route to a new garden.

choices.label: Preserve the wall and build around it.
Ask the spirits for a sign.
Let young and old design a compromise.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The new path honors a cherished landmark.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The detour costs hours of labor.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An irreplaceable carving cracks during the move.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: An unusual bird arrives, but villagers disagree about its meaning.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Nothing unusual happens, and the council must decide.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: A narrow passage preserves most of the wall.

b1__fx.name: Outcome B1
b1__fx.text: The garden expands and the carvings are recorded.

b1__text.name: Outcome B1
b1__text.text: The garden expands and the carvings are recorded.
